title: Height-Balanced Union-Find Invariants for Ruby-Based Compiler Instruction Pipeline Optimization
author: Mateus Yonathan

abstract: Compiler instruction pipelines benefit from dynamic scheduling that preserves data-flow dependencies while minimizing stalls. We present a Ruby-based optimizer that models instruction dependencies as a disjoint-set forest and applies union-by-rank with path compression to maintain a height-balanced structure. The optimizer guarantees that each union and find operation runs in amortized $O(\alpha(n))$ time, where $\alpha$ is the inverse Ackermann function. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor (1 physical core, 2 logical threads) yields a mean latency of 97 607.01 \textmu{}s and a throughput of 10 245 ops/s over 30 iterations. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/ruby-algorithms-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261013_230105_compiler_instruction_pipeline_optimizer}.
